situation: A queue of children and parents outside a brightly painted seaside kiosk on a warm summer afternoon.

brief: A towering double scoop of bright pink strawberry and pale yellow vanilla ice cream sits atop a crisp waffle cone, held up against a clear turquoise sky. A single glossy drop of melted cream begins to slide down the side of the pink sphere.
